summary: Completed full frontend-only regression on public preview for unified spatial journey requirements (desktop 1920x800 and mobile 390x844). Core spatial architecture and most interactions pass, but two blocking UX regressions were reproduced: nondeterministic menu routing and non-functional gallery next/previous scrolling.

ui_bugs.issue: Menu links are not deterministic: Legacy/Timeline/Victories frequently route to ORIGIN (or wrong node) instead of their target spatial node.
Gallery next/previous controls do not change strip position on desktop; scrollLeft remains 0 across repeated clicks despite overflow content.

integration_issues.issue: Direct window.__spatialGo('legacy'|'timeline'|'cars'|'tracks'|'victories'|'footer') routes correctly, but menu-driven navigation is inconsistent/flaky for multiple links.

action_items: Fix menu-link routing determinism so Legacy/Timeline/Cars/Tracks/Victories always trigger correct spatial camera destination from the menu.
Stabilize nav flow around menu open/close animation and routing invocation timing (avoid fallback to wrong destination when spatial router is not yet resolved).
Fix gallery navigation buttons so next/previous reliably update gallery strip scroll position when GALLERY node is active.
Re-run full frontend regression for menu + gallery + timeline + quote + victory interactions after fixes.
critical_code_review_comments: Nav.go fallback path computes destination from getBoundingClientRect of transformed spatial nodes; this is high-risk in camera-transformed layouts and can resolve to incorrect top/origin. Ensure menu always uses the spatial router path or a deterministic route-stop map.
Menu panel uses animated clipPath transition; current interaction timing appears race-prone for routing on quick open->click flows. Add deterministic routing trigger after panel state settles.
Gallery controls are wired, but click results indicate handler/pointer routing is not consistently effective in spatial mode; verify pointer-event activation and event delivery at active-node-4.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Validated PASS: single unified spatial container; no duplicate normal-flow chapter sections outside camera; fresh load starts with full-screen hero; LEWIS/HAMILTON visible during hero minimization phase; timeline wheel does not change year and arrows/buttons work; cars controls work; quote controls change quote; victories filters work; hero stats settle to 105/7/104; images load; no horizontal overflow on desktop/mobile; no console/page errors; back-to-top reaches origin. FAIL: menu routing is nondeterministic for several links, and gallery next/previous does not move strip.
rca of the issue: Repro (menu): open menu -> click Legacy/Timeline/Victories -> often remains at ORIGIN or wrong node, while direct window.__spatialGo calls succeed for same targets. Probable root cause: race/fallback behavior in Nav.go where transformed-section getBoundingClientRect fallback is used or timing conflicts with menu animation. Repro (gallery): route to GALLERY node, verify strip dimensions (clientWidth 1918, scrollWidth 4908), click next/previous repeatedly, scrollLeft stays 0. Probable root cause: interaction not reaching move handler consistently in spatial mode (pointer-event/stacking activation issue) despite visible controls.
